description: Demonstrates group.parent_group_id, the optional nesting extension to the grouped/sibling ResultSets proposal from Discussion #45 (proposed, not yet finalized). Grew out of an explicit audit of EvalPort's flat-group design against real precedent: MLflow's nested runs (mlflow/tracking/fluent.py's active_run_stack) let one run's parent_run_id itself point to a run with its own parent_run_id, forming an arbitrarily deep tree -- confirmed against mlflow/mlflow#16685's real GrandParent/Parent/150-Child test case, not just the API surface. W&B's Run.sweep_id and its separate wandb.init(group=...) primitive are both flat, single-level, with no parent construct anywhere in wandb/wandb's source, so EvalPort's original flat-only design matched W&B but not MLflow. This fixture models a hyperparameter sweep-of-sweeps: a parent group covering the whole learning-rate x batch-size grid, and this ResultSet's own group nested one level under it via parent_group_id. A conforming validator MUST ACCEPT this document -- parent_group_id is optional and, when present, only needs to be a non-empty string that differs from this group's own group_id (see group_self_parent_rejected.json for the negative case).
